title: Cleveland deals that cash-flow, on one map. Then they come to you.
blurb: Deals: DealCaddie underwrites every listing in the market on all 7 strategies, pins each one with its monthly cash flow, and emails new matches from your Buy Box every morning.

do.eval: (async()=>{const L=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const bs=(L||[]).filter(b=>/cleveland/i.test(JSON.stringify(b.markets||'')+' '+(b.name||'')+' '+(b.region_label||'')));if(!bs.length)return 'NO CLEVELAND BOX: '+(L||[]).map(b=>b.id+':'+b.name).join(', ');const b=bs[bs.length-1];const j=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes/'+b.id+'/map',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const rs=(j.rows||[]).filter(r=>r.lat!=null);const good=rs.filter(r=>/analyzed|passed|below_criteria/.test(r.screen_status||''));const use=good.length>=3?good:rs;const med=a=>{a=a.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);return a[a.length>>1]};if(use.length)localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_view_'+b.id,JSON.stringify({lat:med(use.map(r=>r.lat)),lng:med(use.map(r=>r.lng)),z:13,t:Date.now()}));localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_drawer','peek');localStorage.setItem('dc_pin_mode','cf');window.__cleBox=b.id;sessionStorage.setItem('cleBox',b.id);return 'box '+b.id+' '+b.name+' rows '+rs.length+' good '+good.length})()

scenes.line: What if the cash-flowing deals came to you?
DealCaddie underwrites every listing in Cleveland, and each pin shows that deal's monthly cash flow.
One tap flips every pin between cash flow and price.
Add a filter, like positive cash flow only.
The list shows what's left, every one fully underwritten. This one clears {top_cf}/mo.

scenes.line: Save it as a Buy Box, and new matches land in your inbox every morning. The deals find you while you sleep.

wrap: Stop scrolling listings at midnight. Let the deals find you.
cover_sub: Cash flow on every pin. New matches every morning.
why: Your time is worth more than scrolling Zillow every night. Let the cash-flowing deals come to you.
ask: Which city should we search next? 👇
